raw_block.rationale: The Illinois OpenExempt TRAIN pair supports a compact three-skill package: one classifier builds independently valued claims, while two dependent renderers preserve the distinct EC and EV native schemas. It also captures the married-debtor doubling of the $4,000 any-property exemption without importing unavailable federal or out-of-state rules.

origin.quote: The Debtors may claim property exemptions under Illinois statutes.

source_obligations.statement: Apply only Illinois exemptions because the solved choice-of-law step authorizes that regime.

origin.quote: The debtor's equity interest, not to exceed $4,000 in value, in any other property;

source_obligations.statement: Allow each debtor up to $4,000 of equity in any other property and combine the two equal interests for jointly owned property.

origin.quote: Professionally prescribed health aids for the debtor or a dependent of the debtor;

source_obligations.statement: Apply the specific health-aid exemption to a professionally prescribed prosthetic device.

origin.quote: Consider each asset-exemption pair independently, without factoring in aggregate values across multiple assets.

source_obligations.statement: Evaluate each asset-exemption pair independently and never claim more than the asset value or applicable cap.
